newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM August platinum surges by daily limit.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM August platinum surges by daily limit.

text.p: Yen-based August platinum futures surged by their 50 yen per gram daily limit on Tuesday morning, lifted by heavy short-covering, traders said.
"The higher spot platinum prices forced private investors to cover their short positions aggressively," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
Among platinum contracts, distant prices were weaker in morning trade, moving in a different direction from nearby contracts.

"Expectations that prices will slip later this year after Russia resumes exports put downward pressure on distant months," he said. Benchmark April platinum was off five yen at 1,391 yen as of 0189 GMT. Spot trading was quiet.
"The extremely tight supplies in the spot market made trade houses stay away from trading," another trader said.
